get.summary: An artist's photo

200.description: The photo, with the type it was checked to have. Browsers are told not to guess another (`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`), and that they can keep it, only in the admin's browser, never in a shared cache, but have to check with the server before showing it again (`Cache-Control: private, no-cache`). Its `ETag` changes whenever the photo does

304.description: The request's `If-None-Match` has the photo's `ETag`, so the browser already has it: it isn't sent again
